I'd like to make a mechanic that involves glossing the Voynich manuscript. Ideally, players would draw 'Voynichese' word cards, with real transcriptions from the MS, and play them during their turn, building a 'folio' of the manuscript for the round as they go. They would draw and play additional 'section' cards that define what section of the MS they're looking at (eg astrological, pharmacological, botanical, baleological, etc). Some other ideas, not set in stone: Proposing provenance languages (eg Old High German, Piedmontese, Latin, and other obscure and major languages) that other players can agree with or disagree with to determine bonuses for 'translation' attempts, bonuses for 'translation' suggestions having to do with the section defined for that round's folio.

Got any other ideas?
